# Vježba 3 — Statika fluida {.unnumbered}

U ovoj se vježbi raspodjela tlaka čita kao **polje ravnoteže**. Formula $p=p_0+\rho gh$ samo je poseban rezultat tog polja za homogenu tekućinu u jednolikoj gravitaciji; isti način razmišljanja zatim vodi do manometara, uzgona i relativnog mirovanja u ubrzanom spremniku.

## Fizikalni uvod

Fluid je u mirovanju kada se njegove čestice ne gibaju jedna u odnosu na drugu. Zato u njemu nema trajnog smičnog naprezanja. Na mali zamišljeni element djeluju dvije vrste sila: **površinske sile tlaka**, uvijek okomite na plohu, i **volumenska sila** $\rho\mathbf g\,dV$, raspodijeljena po cijelom volumenu.

### 1. Hidrostatsko polje tlaka {.unnumbered}

Promotrimo vertikalni element presjeka $A$ i visine $dz$, pri čemu je os $z$ pozitivna prema gore. Donja ploha potiskuje element prema gore silom $p(z)A$, gornja prema dolje silom $p(z+dz)A$, a težina je $\rho gA\,dz$ prema dolje. Iz ravnoteže slijedi

$$p(z)A-p(z+dz)A-\rho gA\,dz=0.$$

Razvojem $p(z+dz)=p(z)+(dp/dz)dz$ i kraćenjem dobiva se

$$\frac{dp}{dz}=-\rho g.$$

Minus nije dodatno pravilo: pojavljuje se zato što $z$ raste prema gore, a gravitacija i porast tlaka usmjereni su prema dolje. Ako umjesto toga uvedemo dubinu $h$ pozitivnu prema dolje, tada je $dh=-dz$ pa vrijedi $dp/dh=\rho g$ i, za konstantnu gustoću,

$$p=p_0+\rho gh.$$

U vektorskom obliku ista je ravnoteža

$$\nabla p=\rho\mathbf g.$$

Gradijent $\nabla p$ vektor je usmjeren prema **najbržem porastu tlaka**, a njegova je veličina promjena tlaka po jedinici duljine. Središnja poruka stoga glasi: **tlak raste u smjeru efektivne gravitacije**.

Jednak tlak na istoj geodetskoj visini vrijedi samo unutar **istoga povezanog fluida** u istom efektivnom polju. Na idealnom sučelju dvaju mirujućih fluida tlak je kontinuiran, ali se nagib profila mijenja jer je $dp/dh=\rho g$ veći u gušćem fluidu. Za promjenjivu gustoću više ne smijemo pisati jedan umnožak $\rho gh$, nego

$$p_2-p_1=\int_1^2 \rho\,\mathbf g\cdot d\mathbf r,$$

odnosno približno zbroj tankih slojeva $\sum_i \rho_i g\,\Delta h_i$.

### 2. Uzgon kao rezultanta tlaka {.unnumbered}

Na dnu uronjenog tijela tlak je veći nego na vrhu. Vektorski zbroj svih normalnih sila tlaka zato nije nula, nego daje rezultantu prema gore. Integracijom polja $\nabla p=\rho\mathbf g$ po istisnutom volumenu dobiva se

$$\mathbf F_U=-\int_{V_{ist}}\rho\mathbf g\,dV,$$

a za homogeni fluid $F_U=\rho gV_{ist}$. Pravac sile prolazi kroz **centar uzgona**, težište istisnutog volumena. Plutajuće tijelo podešava uronjeni volumen tako da je $F_U=G$; zato isti areometar u gušćoj tekućini treba manji uronjeni volumen i pluta više.

### 3. Relativno mirovanje {.unnumbered}

U sustavu koji translacijski ubrzava s $\mathbf a$ fluid miruje u odnosu na spremnik kada se tlak uravnoteži s efektivnim poljem

$$\mathbf g_{eff}=\mathbf g-\mathbf a,\qquad \nabla p=\rho\mathbf g_{eff},\qquad dp=\rho\mathbf g_{eff}\cdot d\mathbf r.$$

Slobodna površina otvorenog, djelomično ispunjenog spremnika ploha je stalnog tlaka pa je okomita na $\mathbf g_{eff}$. Pri horizontalnom ubrzanju udesno, prividna komponenta $-\mathbf a$ usmjerena je ulijevo i površina se podiže ulijevo. U potpuno ispunjenom zatvorenom spremniku **nema slobodne površine**: minimum i maksimum nalaze se projekcijom krajnjih točaka spremnika na smjer $\mathbf g_{eff}$.

::: {.mf1-bridge}
#### Pravilo manometra

1. Označi točku poznatoga tlaka i nacrtaj kontinuirani **put tlaka** do tražene točke.
2. Pri kretanju prema dolje dodaj $+\rho g\,\Delta h$, a pri kretanju prema gore dodaj $-\rho g\,\Delta h$; pri vodoravnom pomaku u istom fluidu tlak se ne mijenja.
3. Na svakom sučelju zadrži isti tlak, ali promijeni gustoću za sljedeći odsječak puta.
4. Na kraju razlikuj apsolutni tlak $p_{abs}$ i pretlak $p^*=p_{abs}-p_{atm}$. Doprinos plina zanemaruje se samo kada se prethodno procijeni da je malen.
:::

<script>
(function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('v3-intro-canvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    const logicalW = parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || 900;
    const logicalH = parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || 360;
    canvas.width = Math.round(logicalW * ratio);
    canvas.height = Math.round(logicalH * ratio);
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
    ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
    const rhoS = document.getElementById('v3-intro-rho');
    const accS = document.getElementById('v3-intro-acc');
    const depthS = document.getElementById('v3-intro-depth');
    const densityS = document.getElementById('v3-intro-density');
    const sceneCaption = document.getElementById('v3-scene-caption');
    const explainer = document.getElementById('v3-intro-explainer');
    const impact1 = document.getElementById('v3-impact-1');
    const impact2 = document.getElementById('v3-impact-2');
    const impact3 = document.getElementById('v3-impact-3');
    let currentTab = 'dubina';

    window.switchV3Tab = function(tab) {
        currentTab = tab;
        [['dubina','v3-btn-depth'],['manometar','v3-btn-mano'],['ubrzanje','v3-btn-acc']].forEach(([name,id]) => {
            const button = document.getElementById(id);
            const active = tab === name;
            button.style.background = active ? '#2563eb' : '#edf2f7';
            button.style.color = active ? '#ffffff' : '#475569';
            button.style.borderColor = active ? '#2563eb' : '#cbd5e1';
            button.setAttribute('aria-pressed', active ? 'true' : 'false');
        });
        document.getElementById('v3-text-depth').style.display = tab === 'dubina' ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('v3-text-density').style.display = tab === 'dubina' ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('v3-text-mano').style.display = tab === 'manometar' ? 'block' : 'none';
        document.getElementById('v3-text-acc').style.display = tab === 'ubrzanje' ? 'block' : 'none';
        update();
    };

    function drawArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label) {
        const headlen = 10;
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
        ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        if (label) {
            ctx.font = '700 15px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(label, x2 + 8, y2 + 5);
        }
    }

    function updateMetrics(label1, value1, unit1, label2, value2, unit2, label3, value3, unit3) {
        document.getElementById('v3-metric-label-1').textContent = label1;
        document.getElementById('v3-res-1').textContent = value1;
        document.getElementById('v3-unit-1').textContent = unit1;
        document.getElementById('v3-metric-label-2').textContent = label2;
        document.getElementById('v3-res-2').textContent = value2;
        document.getElementById('v3-unit-2').textContent = unit2;
        document.getElementById('v3-metric-label-3').textContent = label3;
        document.getElementById('v3-res-3').textContent = value3;
        document.getElementById('v3-unit-3').textContent = unit3;
    }

    function drawPressureField(depth, rho) {
        const g = 9.81;
        const dp = rho * g * depth / 1000;
        document.getElementById('v3-intro-depth-val').textContent = depth.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('v3-intro-density-val').textContent = rho.toFixed(0);
        updateMetrics('Pretlak na sondi', dp.toFixed(2), ' kPa', 'Gradijent dp/dh', (rho * g / 1000).toFixed(2), ' kPa/m', 'Dubina sonde', depth.toFixed(1), ' m');
        sceneCaption.textContent = 'Strelice su okomite na stijenke, a njihov intenzitet raste s dubinom; desno je isti podatak prikazan nagibom pravca p(h).';
        explainer.textContent = 'Za ρ = ' + rho.toFixed(0) + ' kg/m³ svaki metar dubine dodaje ' + (rho*g/1000).toFixed(2) + ' kPa. Na h = ' + depth.toFixed(1) + ' m pretlak je ' + dp.toFixed(2) + ' kPa. Duljine strelica grafički su ograničene, ali njihove oznake ostaju fizikalne.';
        impact1.textContent = 'h = ' + depth.toFixed(1) + ' m, ρ = ' + rho.toFixed(0) + ' kg/m³';
        impact2.textContent = 'dp/dh = ρg';
        impact3.textContent = 'tlak raste prema dolje';

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        const tx=80, ty=45, tw=360, th=265, surface=78;
        const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,surface,0,ty+th);
        grad.addColorStop(0,'#e0f2fe'); grad.addColorStop(1,'#38bdf8');
        ctx.fillStyle=grad; ctx.fillRect(tx,surface,tw,ty+th-surface);
        ctx.strokeStyle='#334155'; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.strokeRect(tx,ty,tw,th);
        ctx.strokeStyle='#0284c7'; ctx.lineWidth=4; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx,surface); ctx.lineTo(tx+tw,surface); ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle='#075985'; ctx.font='700 14px Inter'; ctx.fillText('p = p₀',tx+12,surface-10);
        [0.3,0.6,0.9].forEach((fraction) => {
            const y=surface+fraction*(ty+th-surface);
            const length=Math.min(58,16+fraction*54);
            drawArrow(tx+length,y,tx+4,y,'#4338ca','');
            drawArrow(tx+tw-length,y,tx+tw-4,y,'#4338ca','');
        });
        const probeY=surface+(depth/3)*(ty+th-surface);
        ctx.setLineDash([7,5]); ctx.strokeStyle='#dc2626'; ctx.lineWidth=2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(tx-8,probeY);ctx.lineTo(tx+tw+8,probeY);ctx.stroke();ctx.setLineDash([]);
        ctx.fillStyle='#b91c1c';ctx.fillText('h = ' + depth.toFixed(1) + ' m',tx+tw+16,probeY+5);
        drawArrow(tx+tw/2,105,tx+tw/2,175,'#d97706','g');

        const gx=555, gy=292, gw=270, gh=225;
        ctx.strokeStyle='#334155';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(gx,gy-gh);ctx.lineTo(gx,gy);ctx.lineTo(gx+gw,gy);ctx.stroke();
        const endX=gx+gw-20,endY=gy-(rho/1400)*(gh-20);
        ctx.strokeStyle='#4338ca';ctx.lineWidth=5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(gx+8,gy-5);ctx.lineTo(endX,endY);ctx.stroke();
        const px=gx+8+(depth/3)*(endX-gx-8), py=gy-5+(depth/3)*(endY-gy+5);
        ctx.fillStyle='#dc2626';ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(px,py,6,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
        ctx.fillStyle='#334155';ctx.font='800 15px Inter';ctx.fillText('p',gx+gw+8,gy+5);ctx.fillText('h',gx-18,gy-gh-6);
        ctx.fillStyle='#4338ca';ctx.fillText('p(h) = p₀ + ρgh',gx+70,gy-gh+22);
    }

    function drawManometer(rho2) {
        const rho1 = 1000;
        const h1 = 1.2;
        const h2 = h1 * (rho1 / rho2);
        const pref = rho1 * 9.81 * h1 / 1000;
        document.getElementById('v3-intro-rho-val').textContent = rho2.toFixed(0);
        updateMetrics('Visina drugog stupca', h2.toFixed(2), ' m', 'Tlak u referentnoj ravnini', pref.toFixed(2), ' kPa', 'Omjer visina h₂/h₁', (h2 / h1).toFixed(2), '');
        sceneCaption.textContent = 'Promjena gustoće ne mijenja uvjet ravnoteže: tlak u istoj referentnoj ravnini mora ostati jednak s obje strane spojene posude.';
        explainer.textContent = `Za ρ₂ = ${rho2.toFixed(0)} kg/m³ drugi stupac mora imati visinu ${h2.toFixed(2)} m kako bi tlak u zajedničkoj referentnoj ravnini ostao ${pref.toFixed(2)} kPa. Gušći fluid treba manju visinu da bi dao isti hidrostatski tlak.`;
        impact1.textContent = `ρ₂ = ${rho2.toFixed(0)} kg/m³`;
        impact2.textContent = 'h₂ = h₁ρ₁ / ρ₂';
        impact3.textContent = 'isti tlak na referentnoj ravnini';

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        const baseY = 290;
        const leftX = 210;
        const rightX = 560;
        const scale = 120;
        const leftTop = baseY - h1 * scale;
        const rightTop = baseY - h2 * scale;

        ctx.lineWidth = 24;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#dbeafe';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(leftX, 70);
        ctx.lineTo(leftX, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(rightX, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(rightX, 70);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2563eb';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(leftX, leftTop);
        ctx.lineTo(leftX, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(385, baseY);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(385, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(rightX, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(rightX, rightTop);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.setLineDash([7, 6]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#16a34a';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(120, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(780, baseY);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
        ctx.font = '800 15px Inter';
        ctx.fillText('referentna ravnina: tlak je jednak s obje strane', 220, baseY + 26);
        ctx.fillText(`ρ₁ = 1000 kg/m³`, 148, leftTop - 18);
        ctx.fillText(`ρ₂ = ${rho2.toFixed(0)} kg/m³`, 520, rightTop - 18);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = '700 14px Inter';
        ctx.fillText(`h₁ = ${h1.toFixed(2)} m`, 148, leftTop - 38);
        ctx.fillText(`h₂ = ${h2.toFixed(2)} m`, 520, rightTop - 38);

        drawArrow(305, leftTop + 12, 305, baseY - 10, '#2563eb', 'ρ₁gh₁');
        drawArrow(650, rightTop + 12, 650, baseY - 10, '#334155', 'ρ₂gh₂');
    }

    function drawAcceleration(ax) {
        const g = 9.81;
        const alpha = Math.atan(ax / g);
        const alphaDeg = alpha * 180 / Math.PI;
        const geff = Math.sqrt(g * g + ax * ax);
        const tankL = 2.2;
        const deltaH = tankL * Math.tan(alpha);
        document.getElementById('v3-intro-acc-val').textContent = ax.toFixed(1);
        updateMetrics('Nagib površine', alphaDeg.toFixed(1), '°', 'Efektivna gravitacija', geff.toFixed(2), ' m/s²', 'Razlika razina Δh', deltaH.toFixed(2), ' m');
        sceneCaption.textContent = 'Kad spremnik ubrzava, slobodna površina zauzima položaj okomit na vektor efektivne gravitacije g_eff.';
        explainer.textContent = `Za aₓ = ${ax.toFixed(1)} m/s² rezultantno polje sila više nije okomito prema dolje nego je nagnuto. Zato se slobodna površina naginje za ${alphaDeg.toFixed(1)}°, a preko duljine spremnika od ${tankL.toFixed(1)} m nastaje razlika razina od približno ${deltaH.toFixed(2)} m.`;
        impact1.textContent = `aₓ = ${ax.toFixed(1)} m/s²`;
        impact2.textContent = 'tan α = aₓ / g';
        impact3.textContent = 'slobodna ploha prati smjer g_eff';

        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, logicalW, logicalH);
        const tankX = 160;
        const tankY = 90;
        const tankW = 420;
        const tankH = 190;
        const hMid = tankY + 92;
        const pxPerMetre = tankW / tankL;
        const dy = (deltaH / 2) * pxPerMetre;

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2937';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.strokeRect(tankX, tankY, tankW, tankH);
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(37,99,235,0.16)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tankX, hMid + dy);
        ctx.lineTo(tankX + tankW, hMid - dy);
        ctx.lineTo(tankX + tankW, tankY + tankH);
        ctx.lineTo(tankX, tankY + tankH);
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();

        ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tankX, hMid);
        ctx.lineTo(tankX + tankW, hMid);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.setLineDash([]);

        ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
        ctx.font = '800 15px Inter';
        ctx.fillText(`α = ${alphaDeg.toFixed(1)}°`, 620, 82);
        ctx.fillText(`Δh ≈ ${deltaH.toFixed(2)} m`, 620, 104);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#64748b';
        ctx.font = '700 14px Inter';
        ctx.fillText('isprekidana: površina bez ubrzanja', 610, 132);
        ctx.fillText('puna kosa: površina u relativnom mirovanju', 610, 152);

        const vx = 710;
        const vy = 220;
        drawArrow(vx, vy, vx, vy + 70, '#d97706', 'g');
        drawArrow(vx, vy, vx - ax * 12, vy, '#dc2626', '-a');
        drawArrow(vx, vy, vx - ax * 12, vy + 70, '#16a34a', 'g_eff');
    }

    function update() {
        if (currentTab === 'dubina') {
            drawPressureField(parseFloat(depthS.value), parseFloat(densityS.value));
        } else if (currentTab === 'manometar') {
            drawManometer(parseFloat(rhoS.value));
        } else {
            drawAcceleration(parseFloat(accS.value));
        }
    }

    rhoS.addEventListener('input', update);
    accS.addEventListener('input', update);
    depthS.addEventListener('input', update);
    densityS.addEventListener('input', update);
    window.switchV3Tab('dubina');
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
    window.mf1HiDpiCanvas = function(canvas) {
        if (!canvas) return null;
        const ratio = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        const logicalWidth = parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || 900;
        const logicalHeight = parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || 360;
        canvas.width = Math.round(logicalWidth * ratio);
        canvas.height = Math.round(logicalHeight * ratio);
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        ctx.setTransform(ratio, 0, 0, ratio, 0, 0);
        ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
        return { ctx, logicalWidth, logicalHeight };
    };

    function triggerInputs(root) {
        root.querySelectorAll('input, select').forEach((el) => {
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
        });
    }

    function setupWidget(widget, idx) {
        if (!widget || widget.querySelector('.mf1-widget-toolbar')) return;
        const ranges = Array.from(widget.querySelectorAll('input[type="range"]'));
        const checks = Array.from(widget.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'));
        const selects = Array.from(widget.querySelectorAll('select'));
        if (ranges.length === 0 && checks.length === 0 && selects.length === 0) return;

        ranges.forEach((range, rangeIndex) => {
            range.dataset.defaultValue = range.value;
            if (!range.id) range.id = `mf1-auto-range-${idx}-${rangeIndex}`;
            range.title = 'Dvoklik vraća klizač na početnu vrijednost';
            range.addEventListener('dblclick', () => {
                range.value = range.dataset.defaultValue;
                range.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
            });
            range.addEventListener('keydown', (ev) => {
                if ((ev.key === 'r' || ev.key === 'R') && !ev.ctrlKey && !ev.altKey && !ev.metaKey) {
                    ev.preventDefault();
                    range.value = range.dataset.defaultValue;
                    range.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
                }
            });
        });

        checks.forEach((check) => {
            check.dataset.defaultChecked = check.checked ? '1' : '0';
        });

        selects.forEach((sel) => {
            sel.dataset.defaultValue = sel.value;
        });

        const toolbar = document.createElement('div');
        toolbar.className = 'mf1-widget-toolbar';
        const hint = document.createElement('span');
        hint.className = 'mf1-input-hint';
        hint.textContent = 'Savjet: dvoklik na klizač vraća samo taj parametar';

        const resetBtn = document.createElement('button');
        resetBtn.type = 'button';
        resetBtn.className = 'mf1-reset-btn';
        resetBtn.textContent = 'Resetiraj widget';
        resetBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            ranges.forEach((range) => {
                range.value = range.dataset.defaultValue;
            });
            checks.forEach((check) => {
                check.checked = check.dataset.defaultChecked === '1';
            });
            selects.forEach((sel) => {
                sel.value = sel.dataset.defaultValue;
            });
            triggerInputs(widget);
        });

        toolbar.appendChild(hint);
        toolbar.appendChild(resetBtn);
        widget.appendChild(toolbar);
    }

    function init() {
        const widgets = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mf1-lab'));
        widgets.forEach(setupWidget);
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }
})();
</script>

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak Z24 — Manometar s više fluida (Prirodni plin) {.unnumbered}

Izmjereni pretlak sustava na slici iznosi 65 kPa. Potrebno je odrediti visinu stupca žive $h_2$. Pretpostavke: Fluid je nestlačiv. Tlak prirodnog plina je uslijed male gustoće jednoliko raspodijeljen u spremniku i u cijevi.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$p_{pm}$ = $65 \, \text{kPa}$, $h_1$ = $0,3 \, \text{m}$, $h_3$ = $0,75 \, \text{m}$, $\bar{\rho}_{Hg}$ = $13,6$, $\bar{\rho}_u$ = $0,72$, $\rho_v$ = $1000 \, \text{kg/m}^3$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$h_2 = ?$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Postavljamo jednadžbu ravnoteže tlakova:
$$p_{pm} + \rho_v g h_1 - \rho_u g h_3 = \rho_{Hg} g h_2$$

Iz čega slijedi visina stupca žive:
$$h_2 = \frac{p_{pm} + \rho_v g h_1 - \rho_u g h_3}{\rho_{Hg} g}$$
$$h_2 = \frac{65000 + 1000 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 0,3 - 720 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 0,75}{13600 \cdot 9,81} = \mathbf{0,469 \, \text{m}}$$

    </div>
    <div class="z24-control">
        <label>Gustoća vode ρ_v: <span id="z24-v3-val-rhov" style="color:#2563eb;">1000</span> kg/m³</label>
        <input type="range" id="z24-v3-slider-rhov" min="980" max="1040" step="1" value="1000" style="accent-color:#2563eb;">
    </div>
    <div class="z24-control">
        <label>Gustoća ulja ρ_u: <span id="z24-v3-val-rhou" style="color:#b7791f;">720</span> kg/m³</label>
        <input type="range" id="z24-v3-slider-rhou" min="650" max="900" step="5" value="720" style="accent-color:#b7791f;">
    </div>
    <div class="z24-control">
        <label>Gustoća manometarske tekućine ρ_m: <span id="z24-v3-val-rhom" style="color:#6b7280;">13600</span> kg/m³</label>
        <input type="range" id="z24-v3-slider-rhom" min="12000" max="14000" step="100" value="13600" style="accent-color:#6b7280;">
    </div>
</div>

<div class="z24-actions">
    <button type="button" class="z24-action is-active" data-z24-scenario="default">Bazni primjer</button>
    <button type="button" class="z24-action" data-z24-scenario="high-gas">Visoki tlak plina</button>
    <button type="button" class="z24-action" data-z24-scenario="oil-dominant">Dominira ulje</button>
</div>

<div class="z24-status" id="z24-v3-status">Režim: uravnotežen standardni slučaj.</div>

<div class="z24-metrics">
    <div class="z24-metric"><small>Potrebna visina žive h₂</small><strong style="color:#6b7280;"><span id="z24-v3-res-h2">0.469</span> m</strong></div>
    <div class="z24-metric"><small>Doprinos plina + vode</small><strong style="color:#2563eb;"><span id="z24-v3-res-rise">67.94</span> kPa</strong></div>
    <div class="z24-metric"><small>Oduzimanje ulja</small><strong style="color:#b7791f;"><span id="z24-v3-res-oil">5.30</span> kPa</strong></div>
    <div class="z24-metric"><small>Ekvivalent tlaka žive</small><strong style="color:#0f766e;"><span id="z24-v3-res-hgdp">62.64</span> kPa</strong></div>
    <div class="z24-metric"><small>Neto rezerva</small><strong style="color:#7c3aed;"><span id="z24-v3-res-margin">92.2</span> %</strong></div>
</div>

<div class="z24-explainer" id="z24-v3-explainer"></div>

<script>
(function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas-z24-v3');
    const hd = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(canvas) : null;
    const ctx = hd ? hd.ctx : canvas.getContext('2d');
    const canvasW = hd ? hd.logicalWidth : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || canvas.width);
    const canvasH = hd ? hd.logicalHeight : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || canvas.height);
    const slP = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-p');
    const slH1 = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-h1');
    const slH3 = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-h3');
    const slRhoV = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-rhov');
    const slRhoU = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-rhou');
    const slRhoM = document.getElementById('z24-v3-slider-rhom');
    const scenarioButtons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-z24-scenario]'));
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('z24-v3-status');
    let phase = 0;

    const scenarios = {
        'default': { p: 65, h1: 0.30, h3: 0.75, rhoV: 1000, rhoU: 720, rhoM: 13600 },
        'high-gas': { p: 120, h1: 0.45, h3: 0.60, rhoV: 1000, rhoU: 720, rhoM: 13600 },
        'oil-dominant': { p: 20, h1: 0.20, h3: 1.60, rhoV: 1000, rhoU: 860, rhoM: 13600 }
    };

    function setActiveScenario(name) {
        scenarioButtons.forEach((btn) => {
            btn.classList.toggle('is-active', btn.dataset.z24Scenario === name);
        });
    }

    function applyScenario(name) {
        const cfg = scenarios[name];
        if (!cfg) return;
        slP.value = cfg.p;
        slH1.value = cfg.h1;
        slH3.value = cfg.h3;
        slRhoV.value = cfg.rhoV;
        slRhoU.value = cfg.rhoU;
        slRhoM.value = cfg.rhoM;
        setActiveScenario(name);
        update();
    }

    function update() {
        const p = parseFloat(slP.value);
        const h1 = parseFloat(slH1.value);
        const h3 = parseFloat(slH3.value);
        const rhoV = parseFloat(slRhoV.value);
        const rhoU = parseFloat(slRhoU.value);
        const rhoM = parseFloat(slRhoM.value);
        const g = 9.81;
        const rise = p + rhoV * g * h1 / 1000;
        const oilOpposition = rhoU * g * h3 / 1000;
        const hgEquivalent = rise - oilOpposition;
        const h2 = (hgEquivalent * 1000) / (rhoM * g);
        const marginPct = rise > 0 ? (100 * hgEquivalent / rise) : 0;

        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-p').textContent = p.toFixed(0);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-h1').textContent = h1.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-h3').textContent = h3.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-rhov').textContent = rhoV.toFixed(0);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-rhou').textContent = rhoU.toFixed(0);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-val-rhom').textContent = rhoM.toFixed(0);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-res-h2').textContent = h2.toFixed(3);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-res-rise').textContent = rise.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-res-oil').textContent = oilOpposition.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-res-hgdp').textContent = hgEquivalent.toFixed(2);
        document.getElementById('z24-v3-res-margin').textContent = marginPct.toFixed(1);
        document.getElementById('z24-path-gas').textContent = 'p* = ' + p.toFixed(1).replace('.', ',') + ' kPa';
        document.getElementById('z24-path-water').textContent = '+' + (rhoV*g*h1/1000).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') + ' kPa';
        document.getElementById('z24-path-hg').textContent = '−' + Math.abs(hgEquivalent).toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') + ' kPa';
        document.getElementById('z24-path-oil').textContent = '−' + oilOpposition.toFixed(2).replace('.', ',') + ' kPa';

        if (hgEquivalent < 0) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Režim: uljni stupac nadvladava pogonski tlak i traženi smjer stupca žive se obrće.';
            statusEl.style.background = '#fef2f2';
            statusEl.style.borderColor = '#fecaca';
            statusEl.style.color = '#991b1b';
        } else if (h2 > 0.7) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Režim: potrebna je velika visina žive; sustav je blizu mjernog limita laboratorijskog manometra.';
            statusEl.style.background = '#fff7ed';
            statusEl.style.borderColor = '#fdba74';
            statusEl.style.color = '#9a3412';
        } else if (marginPct < 15) {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Režim: gotovo uravnoteženo; mala promjena parametara lako mijenja potrebnu visinu žive.';
            statusEl.style.background = '#f5f3ff';
            statusEl.style.borderColor = '#ddd6fe';
            statusEl.style.color = '#5b21b6';
        } else {
            statusEl.textContent = 'Režim: uravnotežen standardni slučaj.';
            statusEl.style.background = '#eff6ff';
            statusEl.style.borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
            statusEl.style.color = '#1e3a8a';
        }

        document.getElementById('z24-v3-explainer').textContent = `Pretlak plina od ${p.toFixed(0)} kPa i vodeni stupac ${h1.toFixed(2)} m (ρ_v=${rhoV.toFixed(0)} kg/m³) zajedno daju ${rise.toFixed(2)} kPa. Ulje (ρ_u=${rhoU.toFixed(0)} kg/m³) oduzima ${oilOpposition.toFixed(2)} kPa, a manometarska tekućina (ρ_m=${rhoM.toFixed(0)} kg/m³) taj ostatak prevodi u visinu. Zato je potrebna visina h₂ = ${h2.toFixed(3)} m.`;

        draw(p, h1, h2, h3, rise, oilOpposition);
    }

    function drawArrow(x1, y1, x2, y2, color, label) {
        const headlen = 10;
        const angle = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
        ctx.strokeStyle = color;
        ctx.fillStyle = color;
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x1, y1);
        ctx.lineTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(x2, y2);
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle - Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle - Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.lineTo(x2 - headlen * Math.cos(angle + Math.PI / 6), y2 - headlen * Math.sin(angle + Math.PI / 6));
        ctx.closePath();
        ctx.fill();
        if (label) {
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(label, x2 + 8, y2 + 4);
        }
    }

    function draw(p, h1, h2, h3, rise, oilOpposition) {
        phase += 0.04;
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);

        const tankX = 60;
        const tankY = 65;
        const tankW = 180;
        const tankH = 120;
        const ox = 340;
        const baseY = 300;
        const scale = 180;

        ctx.fillStyle = '#fef3c7';
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#d97706';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.roundRect(tankX, tankY, tankW, tankH, 18);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.fillStyle = '#92400e';
        ctx.font = 'bold 14px Inter';
        ctx.fillText('PRIRODNI PLIN', tankX + 34, tankY + 28);
        ctx.fillText(`p_pm = ${p.toFixed(0)} kPa`, tankX + 46, tankY + 50);
        for (let i = 0; i < 18; i += 1) {
            const px = tankX + 20 + (i % 6) * 26 + Math.sin(phase + i) * 3;
            const py = tankY + 40 + Math.floor(i / 6) * 24 + Math.cos(phase + i) * 3;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(217,119,6,0.45)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(px, py, 2.4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
        }

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#fde68a';
        ctx.lineWidth = 20;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(tankX + tankW, tankY + tankH / 2);
        ctx.lineTo(ox, tankY + tankH / 2);
        ctx.stroke();

        const y1Start = tankY + tankH / 2;
        const y1End = y1Start + h1 * scale;
        const ox2 = ox + 130;
        const y2End = baseY - h2 * scale;
        const y3End = y2End - h3 * scale;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        ctx.lineWidth = 18;

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#2563eb';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ox, y1Start);
        ctx.lineTo(ox, y1End);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#6b7280';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ox, y1End);
        ctx.lineTo(ox, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(ox2, baseY);
        ctx.lineTo(ox2, y2End);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.strokeStyle = '#d69e2e';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.moveTo(ox2, y2End);
        ctx.lineTo(ox2, y3End);
        ctx.stroke();

        ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
        ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter';
        ctx.fillText('voda', ox - 16, y1End + 26);
        ctx.fillText('živa', ox2 - 16, baseY + 26);
        ctx.fillText('ulje', ox2 + 18, y3End + 6);
        ctx.fillStyle = '#ef4444';
        ctx.fillText('p_atm', ox2 - 10, y3End - 16);

        drawArrow(700, 85, 700, 130, '#2563eb', `+${rise.toFixed(1)} kPa`);
        drawArrow(760, 180, 760, 135, '#b7791f', `-${oilOpposition.toFixed(1)} kPa`);
        drawArrow(820, 130, 820, 220, '#6b7280', `h₂ = ${h2.toFixed(3)} m`);
    }

    [slP, slH1, slH3, slRhoV, slRhoU, slRhoM].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', () => {
        setActiveScenario('');
        update();
    }));
    scenarioButtons.forEach((btn) => btn.addEventListener('click', () => applyScenario(btn.dataset.z24Scenario)));
    applyScenario('default');
})();
</script>
</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Ravnoteža se postiže kada stupac žive ($h_2$) balansira tlak plina, težinu vode i suprotni uzgon stupca ulja ($h_3$).
</div>
```

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak Z25 — Ravnoteža klipa i tlak u komorama {.unnumbered}

Dvije komore koje međusobno povezuje istovrstan fluid (voda gustoće $\rho_v$) odvojene su međusobno putem klipa čija težina iznosi 25 N, prikazano na slici. Potrebno je odrediti pretlak u komorama A i B. Zanemariti utjecaj visine stupca zraka.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$G_k$ = $25 \, \text{N}$, $\rho_v$ = $1000 \, \text{kg/m}^3$, $d_1$ = $0,3 \, \text{m}$, $h_1$ = $0,25 \, \text{m}$, $h_2$ = $0,5 \, \text{m}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$p_A = ?$; $p_B = ?$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

1. **Pretlak pod klipom:**
$$p_c^* = \frac{G_k}{A_k} = \frac{G_k}{d_1^2 \cdot \pi / 4} = \frac{25}{0,0707} = \mathbf{353,6 \, \text{Pa}}$$

2. **Pretlak u komori A:**
$$p_A^* = p_c^* + \rho_v g h_1 = 353,6 + 1000 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 0,25 = \mathbf{2806 \, \text{Pa}}$$

3. **Pretlak u komori B:**
$$p_B^* = p_c^* - \rho_v g (h_2 - h_1) = 353,6 - 1000 \cdot 9,81 \cdot (0,5 - 0,25) = \mathbf{-2099 \, \text{Pa}}$$

Težina klipa najprije određuje samo lokalni pretlak neposredno pod klipom $p_c^*$. Tlakove u komorama A i B potom dobivamo zasebnim hidrostatskim hodom prema njihovim visinama; negativan rezultat za B ovdje je manometarski, ne apsolutni tlak.

    <div class="z25-head">

            <div class="z25-kicker">Z25 laboratorij klipa</div>

    <div class="z25-metrics">
        <div class="z25-metric"><small>Bazni tlak p_c</small><strong style="color:#0f766e;"><span id="z25-v3-res-pc">0.354</span> kPa</strong></div>
        <div class="z25-metric"><small>Pretlak u A</small><strong style="color:#1d4ed8;"><span id="z25-v3-res-pA">2.81</span> kPa</strong></div>
        <div class="z25-metric"><small>Pretlak u B</small><strong style="color:#7c3aed;"><span id="z25-v3-res-pB">-2.10</span> kPa</strong></div>
        <div class="z25-metric"><small>Apsolutni tlak u B</small><strong style="color:#be123c;"><span id="z25-v3-res-pBabs">99.2</span> kPa</strong></div>
        <div class="z25-metric"><small>Stanje komore B</small><strong style="color:#b45309;" id="z25-v3-res-state">vakuumski režim</strong></div>
    </div>
    <div class="z25-explainer" id="z25-v3-explainer"></div>
    <script>
    (function() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('canvas-z25-v3');
        const hd = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(canvas) : null;
        const ctx = hd ? hd.ctx : canvas.getContext('2d');
        const canvasW = hd ? hd.logicalWidth : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || canvas.width);
        const canvasH = hd ? hd.logicalHeight : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || canvas.height);
        const slG = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-g');
        const slD = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-d');
        const slRho = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-rho');
        const slH1 = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-h1');
        const slH2 = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-h2');
        const slPatm = document.getElementById('z25-v3-slider-patm');
        const bandEl = document.getElementById('z25-v3-band');

        function update() {
            const G = parseFloat(slG.value);
            const dMm = parseFloat(slD.value);
            const d = dMm / 1000;
            const area = Math.PI * d * d / 4;
            const rho = parseFloat(slRho.value);
            const g = 9.81;
            const h1 = parseFloat(slH1.value);
            const h2 = parseFloat(slH2.value);
            const pAtm = parseFloat(slPatm.value) * 1000;
            const pc = G / area;
            const pA = pc + rho * g * h1;
            const pB = pc - rho * g * (h2 - h1);
            const pBabs = pAtm + pB;

            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-g').textContent = G.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-d').textContent = dMm.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-rho').textContent = rho.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-h1').textContent = h1.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-h2').textContent = h2.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-val-patm').textContent = (pAtm / 1000).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-res-pc').textContent = (pc / 1000).toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-res-pA').textContent = (pA / 1000).toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-res-pB').textContent = (pB / 1000).toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-res-pBabs').textContent = (pBabs / 1000).toFixed(1);

            let stateText = 'pozitivan pretlak';
            if (pB < 0) stateText = 'vakuumski režim';
            if (pBabs < 30000) stateText = 'duboki vakuum';
            if (pBabs < 2300) stateText = 'rizik isparavanja';
            document.getElementById('z25-v3-res-state').textContent = stateText;

            if (pBabs < 2300) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Upozorenje: apsolutni tlak u B je ispod tlaka isparavanja vode (~2,3 kPa) — model ulazi u dvofazno područje.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fef2f2';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fecaca';
                bandEl.style.color = '#991b1b';
            } else if (pB < 0) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: vakuum u komori B, ali jednofazni model fluida i dalje je primjenjiv.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fff7ed';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fdba74';
                bandEl.style.color = '#9a3412';
            } else {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: obje komore imaju pozitivan pretlak.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#eff6ff';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
                bandEl.style.color = '#1e3a8a';
            }

            document.getElementById('z25-v3-explainer').textContent = `Za G=${G.toFixed(0)} N, d=${dMm.toFixed(0)} mm i ρ=${rho.toFixed(0)} kg/m³ bazni tlak je ${(pc / 1000).toFixed(3)} kPa. Dobiva se p_A=${(pA / 1000).toFixed(2)} kPa, p_B=${(pB / 1000).toFixed(2)} kPa i apsolutni tlak u B ${(pBabs / 1000).toFixed(1)} kPa.`;
            draw(G, dMm, pA, pB, pc);
        }

        function draw(G, dMm, pA, pB, pc) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            const cx = 430;
            const cy = 180;
            const tubeW = dMm * 0.36;
            const leftBoxY = 245;
            const rightBoxY = 80;

            ctx.fillStyle = '#eff6ff';
            ctx.fillRect(90, leftBoxY, 120, 90);
            ctx.fillStyle = pB < 0 ? '#faf5ff' : '#f0fdf4';
            ctx.fillRect(690, rightBoxY, 120, 90);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(90, leftBoxY, 120, 90);
            ctx.strokeRect(690, rightBoxY, 120, 90);

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(37,99,235,0.22)';
            ctx.fillRect(cx - tubeW / 2, cy, tubeW, 120);
            ctx.fillRect(210, cy + 90, cx - tubeW / 2 - 210, 30);
            ctx.fillRect(cx + tubeW / 2, cy + 90, 690 - (cx + tubeW / 2), 30);
            ctx.fillRect(90, cy + 90, 120, 30);
            ctx.fillRect(690, rightBoxY + 60, 120, 30);
            ctx.fillRect(690, rightBoxY + 60, 30, 150);

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2937';
            ctx.lineWidth = 4;
            ctx.strokeRect(cx - tubeW / 2, 40, tubeW, 260);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(210, cy + 105);
            ctx.lineTo(690, cy + 105);
            ctx.stroke();

            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - tubeW / 2, 0, cx + tubeW / 2, 0);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#64748b');
            grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#e2e8f0');
            grad.addColorStop(1, '#475569');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.fillRect(cx - tubeW / 2 + 2, cy - 18, tubeW - 4, 36);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.strokeRect(cx - tubeW / 2 + 2, cy - 18, tubeW - 4, 36);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText('A', 145, leftBoxY + 52);
            ctx.fillText('B', 744, rightBoxY + 52);
            ctx.fillText(`p_c = ${(pc / 1000).toFixed(3)} kPa`, 520, 42);
            ctx.fillText(`p_A = ${(pA / 1000).toFixed(2)} kPa`, 74, leftBoxY - 12);
            ctx.fillText(`p_B = ${(pB / 1000).toFixed(2)} kPa`, 668, rightBoxY - 12);

            // Slobodno tijelo klipa: sila tlaka p_c A prema gore i težina G_k prema dolje.
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#16a34a';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#16a34a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy + 66);
            ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + 22);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx - 8, cy + 32);
            ctx.lineTo(cx, cy + 22);
            ctx.lineTo(cx + 8, cy + 32);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#166534';
            ctx.font = '700 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText('p_c A', cx + 12, cy + 55);

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#d97706';
            ctx.fillStyle = '#d97706';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx, cy - 66);
            ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - 22);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx - 8, cy - 32);
            ctx.lineTo(cx, cy - 22);
            ctx.lineTo(cx + 8, cy - 32);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#92400e';
            ctx.fillText('G_k', cx + 12, cy - 48);

            ctx.strokeStyle = '#64748b';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(cx - tubeW / 2, cy + 32);
            ctx.lineTo(cx + tubeW / 2, cy + 32);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#475569';
            ctx.fillText('d = ' + dMm.toFixed(0) + ' mm', cx - 38, cy + 84);
        }

        [slG, slD, slRho, slH1, slH2, slPatm].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', update));
        update();
    })();
    </script>
</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Klip stvara bazni pretlak $p_c = G_k/A_k$. Zbog visinske razlike $h_1$ i $h_2$, tlak u komori A je veći, dok u B može nastupiti vakuum.
</div>
```

### Zadatak Z30 — Areometar {.unnumbered}

Gustoću tekućine potrebno je odrediti starim areometrom prikazanim na slici čiji promjer iznosi $d = 1 \, \text{cm}$, a oznake su potpuno izblijedile. Areometar se prvo uranja u vodu, pri čemu se obilježava mjesto na kojemu areometar izvire iz vode. Potom se areometar ubacuje u drugu tekućinu, te se primjećuje da je očitanje sada na mjestu koje je za $h_2 = 0,5 \, \text{cm}$ geodetski više od prethodnog očitanja. Ukoliko je visina očitanja od dna areometra do oznake za vodu iznosila $h_1 = 10 \, \text{cm}$, potrebno je odrediti gustoću druge tekućine.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$d$ = $0,01 \, \text{m}$, $h_1$ = $0,1 \, \text{m}$, $h_2$ = $0,005 \, \text{m}$, $\rho_v$ = $1000 \, \text{kg/m}^3$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">gustoću tekućine $\rho_? = ?$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Iz Arhimedova zakona slijedi da je težina areometra jednaka težini istisnute tekućine. Budući da areometar pliva u oba slučaja:
$$\rho_v \cdot V_v = \rho_? \cdot V_?$$
$$\rho_v \cdot A \cdot h_1 = \rho_? \cdot A \cdot (h_1 - h_2)$$

Gustoća nepoznate tekućine:
$$\rho_? = \rho_v \cdot \frac{h_1}{h_1 - h_2}$$
$$\rho_? = 1000 \cdot \frac{0,1}{0,1 - 0,005} = \mathbf{1052,6 \, \text{kg/m}^3}$$

    <script>
    (function() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('z30-canvas');
        const hd = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(canvas) : null;
        const ctx = hd ? hd.ctx : canvas.getContext('2d');
        const canvasW = hd ? hd.logicalWidth : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || canvas.width);
        const canvasH = hd ? hd.logicalHeight : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || canvas.height);
        const h2S = document.getElementById('z30-h2');
        const h1S = document.getElementById('z30-h1');
        const sigmaS = document.getElementById('z30-sigma');
        const rhoRefS = document.getElementById('z30-rhref');
        const bandEl = document.getElementById('z30-status-band');

        function setPreset(h2Value, h1Value) {
            h2S.value = h2Value;
            h1S.value = h1Value;
            update();
        }

        function update() {
            const h2 = parseFloat(h2S.value);
            const h1 = parseFloat(h1S.value);
            const sigma = parseFloat(sigmaS.value);
            const rhoRef = parseFloat(rhoRefS.value);
            const submerged = h1 - h2;
            const safeSubmerged = Math.max(submerged, 0.5);
            const rho = rhoRef * h1 / safeSubmerged;
            const ratio = rho / rhoRef;
            const subLow = Math.max(h1 - (h2 + sigma), 0.5);
            const subHigh = Math.max(h1 - (h2 - sigma), 0.5);
            const rhoHigh = rhoRef * h1 / subLow;
            const rhoLow = rhoRef * h1 / subHigh;

            document.getElementById('z30-v-h2').textContent = h2.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z30-v-h1').textContent = h1.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z30-v-sigma').textContent = sigma.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z30-v-rhref').textContent = rhoRef.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z30-v-rho').textContent = rho.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z30-rho-range').textContent = `${rhoLow.toFixed(0)} - ${rhoHigh.toFixed(0)}`;
            document.getElementById('z30-res-hwater').textContent = h1.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z30-res-hfluid').textContent = safeSubmerged.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z30-ratio').textContent = ratio.toFixed(3);
            const status = h2 > 0 ? 'gušća od reference' : (h2 < 0 ? 'rjeđa od reference' : 'jednaka referenci');
            document.getElementById('z30-status').textContent = status;
            if (submerged <= 0.5) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: geometrijska granica areometra (h₁ − h₂ ≈ 0). U tom području model postaje nestabilan.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fef2f2';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fecaca';
                bandEl.style.color = '#991b1b';
            } else if (Math.abs(ratio - 1) < 0.03) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: gustoća je gotovo jednaka vodi, zato su i uranjanja vrlo slična.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#eff6ff';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
                bandEl.style.color = '#1e3a8a';
            } else if (ratio > 1) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: tekućina je osjetno gušća od vode; areometar pluta pliće.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#ecfdf5';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#86efac';
                bandEl.style.color = '#166534';
            } else {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: tekućina je osjetno rjeđa od vode; areometar tone dublje.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fff7ed';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fdba74';
                bandEl.style.color = '#9a3412';
            }
            document.getElementById('z30-explainer').textContent = `Ako je očitanje u drugoj tekućini ${h2.toFixed(1)} mm više nego u referenci, areometar uranja ${safeSubmerged.toFixed(1)} mm. Za ρ_ref=${rhoRef.toFixed(0)} kg/m³ dobiva se gustoća ${rho.toFixed(1)} kg/m³ (${status}). Uz nesigurnost ±${sigma.toFixed(1)} mm, gustoća je u intervalu ${rhoLow.toFixed(0)} do ${rhoHigh.toFixed(0)} kg/m³.`;
            draw(h1, safeSubmerged, h2, rho);
        }

        function draw(hWater, hFluid, h2, rho) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            const surfaceY = 130;
            const scale = 1.45;
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(96,165,250,0.18)';
            ctx.fillRect(80, surfaceY, 240, 180);
            ctx.fillStyle = rho > 1000 ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.15)' : 'rgba(251,146,60,0.16)';
            ctx.fillRect(560, surfaceY, 240, 180);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#334155';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(80, 70, 240, 240);
            ctx.strokeRect(560, 70, 240, 240);
            drawHydrometer(200, surfaceY, hWater * scale, '#cbd5e1', 'voda');
            drawHydrometer(680, surfaceY, hFluid * scale, '#f8fafc', 'nepoznata');
            [200,680].forEach((x) => {
                ctx.lineWidth=3;
                ctx.strokeStyle='#16a34a';ctx.fillStyle='#16a34a';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+52,surfaceY+75);ctx.lineTo(x+52,surfaceY+25);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+45,surfaceY+35);ctx.lineTo(x+52,surfaceY+25);ctx.lineTo(x+59,surfaceY+35);ctx.fill();
                ctx.strokeStyle='#d97706';ctx.fillStyle='#d97706';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-52,surfaceY-35);ctx.lineTo(x-52,surfaceY+15);ctx.stroke();ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x-59,surfaceY+5);ctx.lineTo(x-52,surfaceY+15);ctx.lineTo(x-45,surfaceY+5);ctx.fill();
                ctx.font='700 12px Inter';ctx.fillStyle='#166534';ctx.fillText('Fᵤ',x+62,surfaceY+55);ctx.fillStyle='#92400e';ctx.fillText('G',x-72,surfaceY-8);
            });

            const markWater = surfaceY - (190 - hWater * scale);
            const markFluid = surfaceY - (190 - hFluid * scale);
            ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(200, markWater);
            ctx.lineTo(680, markWater);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#dc2626';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(730, markWater);
            ctx.lineTo(730, markFluid);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#dc2626';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(`h₂ = ${h2.toFixed(1)} mm`, 742, (markWater + markFluid) / 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.fillText(`ρ = ${rho.toFixed(1)} kg/m³`, 616, 42);
        }

        function drawHydrometer(x, surfaceY, immersed, color, label) {
            const total = 190;
            const topY = surfaceY - (total - immersed);
            ctx.fillStyle = color;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.lineWidth = 2;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(x - 8, topY);
            ctx.lineTo(x + 8, topY);
            ctx.lineTo(x + 8, surfaceY + immersed - 44);
            ctx.lineTo(x + 24, surfaceY + immersed - 34);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 24, surfaceY + immersed, x, surfaceY + immersed);
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x - 24, surfaceY + immersed, x - 24, surfaceY + immersed - 34);
            ctx.lineTo(x - 8, surfaceY + immersed - 44);
            ctx.closePath();
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.fillStyle = '#334155';
            ctx.font = 'bold 12px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(label, x - 22, surfaceY + 198);
        }

        [h2S, h1S, sigmaS, rhoRefS].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', update));
        document.getElementById('z30-preset-light').addEventListener('click', () => setPreset(-12, 100));
        document.getElementById('z30-preset-neutral').addEventListener('click', () => setPreset(0, 100));
        document.getElementById('z30-preset-heavy').addEventListener('click', () => setPreset(12, 100));
        update();
    })();
    </script>
</div>

```

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak Z31 — Ubrzanje spremnika - Orijentacija {.unnumbered}

Spremnik pravokutnog presjeka visine 80 cm, tlocrtnih dimenzija 2 m x 0,6 m, napunjen je vodom. Potrebno ga je transportirati vozilom koje jednoliko ubrzava od stanja mirovanja do brzine od 90 km/h u vremenu od 10 s. Potrebno je odrediti dopuštenu inicijalnu visinu vode u spremniku pri kojoj neće doći do prelijevanja. Također, odredite koja je orijentacija spremnika naspram smjera vožnje povoljnija.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$h_s$ = $0,8 \, \text{m}$, $l$ = $2,0 \, \text{m}$, $b$ = $0,6 \, \text{m}$, $v_k$ = $90 \, \text{km/h} = 25 \, \text{m/s}$, $\Delta t$ = $10 \, \text{s}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$h_{vmax; l \times b} = ?$; $h_{vmax; b \times l} = ?$; povoljnija orijentacija</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Ubrzanje vozila:
$$a_x = \frac{v_k - v_0}{\Delta t} = \frac{25 - 0}{10} = \mathbf{2,5 \, \text{m/s}^2}$$

Nagib slobodne površine:
$$\tan \alpha = \frac{a_x}{g} = \frac{2,5}{9,81} = 0,2548$$

Maksimalna visina punjenja:
$$h_{max} = h_s - \Delta h = h_s - \frac{L}{2} \tan \alpha$$

1. **Orijentacija dužom stranom u smjeru vožnje ($L = 2,0 \, \text{m}$):**
$$h_{vmax} = 0,8 - \frac{2,0}{2} \cdot 0,2548 = \mathbf{0,545 \, \text{m}}$$

2. **Orijentacija kraćom stranom u smjeru vožnje ($L = 0,6 \, \text{m}$):**
$$h_{vmax} = 0,8 - \frac{0,6}{2} \cdot 0,2548 = \mathbf{0,724 \, \text{m}}$$

**Zaključak:** Povoljnije je transportirati spremnik tako da je kraća stranica paralelna sa smjerom vožnje jer dopušta veći nivo punjenja.

                <div class="z31-impact-card"><small>Stanje spremnika</small><strong id="z31-impact-3">kraća orijentacija je sigurnija</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div class="z31-explainer" id="z31-v3-band" style="margin-bottom:12px; font-weight:700;">Režim: sigurno za kraću orijentaciju, rubno za dužu.</div>
            <div class="z31-metrics">
                <div class="z31-metric"><small>Kut površine α</small><strong style="color:#0f172a;"><span id="z31-v3-res-alpha">14.3</span>°</strong></div>
                <div class="z31-metric"><small>Dopušteni nivo za L_d</small><strong style="color:#1d4ed8;"><span id="z31-v3-hlong">0.545</span> m</strong></div>
                <div class="z31-metric"><small>Dopušteni nivo za L_k</small><strong style="color:#0f766e;"><span id="z31-v3-hshort">0.724</span> m</strong></div>
                <div class="z31-metric"><small>Sigurnosna margina (L_d)</small><strong style="color:#be123c;"><span id="z31-v3-margin">-0.005</span> m</strong></div>
                <div class="z31-metric"><small>Povoljnija orijentacija</small><strong style="color:#b45309;" id="z31-v3-better">kraća strana naprijed</strong></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
    (function() {
        const slAx = document.getElementById('z31-v3-slider-ax');
        const slHi = document.getElementById('z31-v3-slider-hi');
        const slHs = document.getElementById('z31-v3-slider-hs');
        const slLl = document.getElementById('z31-v3-slider-ll');
        const slLs = document.getElementById('z31-v3-slider-ls');
        const cLong = document.getElementById('canvas-z31-v3-long');
        const cShort = document.getElementById('canvas-z31-v3-short');
        const hdL = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(cLong) : null;
        const hdS = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(cShort) : null;
        const ctxL = hdL ? hdL.ctx : cLong.getContext('2d');
        const ctxS = hdS ? hdS.ctx : cShort.getContext('2d');
        const bandEl = document.getElementById('z31-v3-band');

        function update() {
            const ax = parseFloat(slAx.value);
            const hInit = parseFloat(slHi.value);
            const hTank = parseFloat(slHs.value);
            const longL = parseFloat(slLl.value);
            const shortL = parseFloat(slLs.value);
            const g = 9.81;
            const alpha = Math.atan(ax / g);
            const alphaDeg = alpha * 180 / Math.PI;
            const longMax = hTank - (longL / 2) * Math.tan(alpha);
            const shortMax = hTank - (shortL / 2) * Math.tan(alpha);
            const marginLong = longMax - hInit;

            document.getElementById('z31-v3-val-ax').textContent = ax.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-val-hi').textContent = hInit.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-val-hs').textContent = hTank.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-val-ll').textContent = longL.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-val-ls').textContent = shortL.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-res-alpha').textContent = alphaDeg.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-hlong').textContent = longMax.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-hshort').textContent = shortMax.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-margin').textContent = marginLong.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-better').textContent = shortMax > longMax ? 'kraća strana naprijed' : 'duža strana naprijed';
            document.getElementById('z31-impact-1').textContent = `aₓ = ${ax.toFixed(1)} m/s²`;
            document.getElementById('z31-impact-2').textContent = `tan α = ${(ax / 9.81).toFixed(3)}`;
            if (marginLong < 0) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: prelijevanje u dugoj orijentaciji — smanji početno punjenje ili ubrzanje.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fef2f2';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fecaca';
                bandEl.style.color = '#991b1b';
                document.getElementById('z31-impact-3').textContent = 'duga orijentacija prelijeva';
            } else if (marginLong < 0.03) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: rubna sigurnost u dugoj orijentaciji; mala rezerva protiv prelijevanja.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fff7ed';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fdba74';
                bandEl.style.color = '#9a3412';
                document.getElementById('z31-impact-3').textContent = 'mala sigurnosna rezerva';
            } else {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: sigurno punjenje u obje orijentacije.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#eff6ff';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
                bandEl.style.color = '#1e3a8a';
                document.getElementById('z31-impact-3').textContent = 'obje orijentacije sigurne';
            }
            document.getElementById('z31-v3-explainer').textContent = `Za ubrzanje ${ax.toFixed(1)} m/s² površina je pod kutom ${alphaDeg.toFixed(1)}°. Za h_s=${hTank.toFixed(2)} m i h_i=${hInit.toFixed(2)} m, duga orijentacija (L_d=${longL.toFixed(2)} m) dopušta ${longMax.toFixed(3)} m, kratka (L_k=${shortL.toFixed(2)} m) ${shortMax.toFixed(3)} m.`;
            draw(ctxL, longL, hTank, hInit, alpha, longMax);
            draw(ctxS, shortL, hTank, hInit, alpha, shortMax);
        }

        function draw(ctx, L, hTank, hInit, alpha, hSafe) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 420, 220);
            const scale = 140;
            const ox = 210 - L * scale / 2;
            const oy = 185;
            const dh = (L / 2) * Math.tan(alpha);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2937';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(ox, oy - hTank * scale, L * scale, hTank * scale);
            ctx.save();
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.rect(ox, oy - hTank * scale, L * scale, hTank * scale);
            ctx.clip();
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(56,189,248,0.48)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ox, oy - (hInit + dh) * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + L * scale, oy - (hInit - dh) * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + L * scale, oy);
            ctx.lineTo(ox, oy);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.restore();
            ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#94a3b8';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ox, oy - hSafe * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + L * scale, oy - hSafe * scale);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.font = '800 14px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(`h_vmax = ${hSafe.toFixed(3)} m`, 18, 20);
            ctx.fillText(hInit > hSafe ? 'prelijevanje' : 'sigurno', 18, 38);
            const vx=355,vy=62,axLen=Math.min(48,Math.tan(alpha)*150);
            const arrow=(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,label) => {
                const angle=Math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1),head=7;
                ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2.5;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x2,y2);ctx.lineTo(x2-head*Math.cos(angle-.55),y2-head*Math.sin(angle-.55));ctx.lineTo(x2-head*Math.cos(angle+.55),y2-head*Math.sin(angle+.55));ctx.fill();
                ctx.font='700 11px Inter';ctx.fillText(label,x2+4,y2+3);
            };
            arrow(vx,vy,vx,vy+45,'#d97706','g');
            arrow(vx,vy,vx-axLen,vy,'#dc2626','−a');
            arrow(vx,vy,vx-axLen,vy+45,'#16a34a','g_eff');
            ctx.fillStyle='#475569';ctx.font='700 11px Inter';ctx.fillText('slobodna ploha ⟂ g_eff',245,208);
        }

        [slAx, slHi, slHs, slLl, slLs].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', update));
        update();
    })();
    </script>
</div>

<div class="fizikalni-uvid">
Nagib slobodne površine ovisi samo o ubrzanju, dok visinska razlika na rubovima ovisi i o duljini spremnika u smjeru gibanja. Ako je kraća stranica usmjerena u smjeru vožnje, smanjuje se opasnost od prelijevanja.
</div>
```

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak Z32 — Otvoreni ubrzani spremnik: tlak na dnu {.unnumbered}

Otvoreni spremnik pravokutnog presjeka giba se pravocrtno u smjeru dulje baze jednolikim ubrzanjem iznosa 2,4 $\text{m/s}^2$. Duljina, širina i visina spremnika iznose 6 m, 2,5 m i 2 m. Ukoliko je spremnik ispunjen vodom do visine 1 m, potrebno je odrediti nagib slobodne površine uslijed pravocrtnog ubrzanja, kao i iznose maksimalnog i minimalnog tlaka na dnu spremnika.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$a_x$ = $2,4 \, \text{m/s}^2$, $L$ = $6 \, \text{m}$, $b$ = $2,5 \, \text{m}$, $h_s$ = $2,0 \, \text{m}$, $h_0$ = $1,0 \, \text{m}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">nagib površine $\alpha = ?$; $p_{dmax} = ?$; $p_{dmin} = ?$</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Nagib slobodne površine:
$$\tan \alpha = \frac{a_x}{g} = \frac{2,4}{9,81} = 0,2446 \implies \alpha = \mathbf{13,75^\circ}$$

Maksimalna i minimalna visina stupca vode na dnu:
$$h_{max} = h_0 + \frac{L}{2} \tan \alpha = 1,0 + \frac{6,0}{2} \cdot 0,2446 = \mathbf{1,734 \, \text{m}}$$
$$h_{min} = h_0 - \frac{L}{2} \tan \alpha = 1,0 - \frac{6,0}{2} \cdot 0,2446 = \mathbf{0,266 \, \text{m}}$$

Tlakovi na dnu:
$$p_{dmax} = \rho \cdot g \cdot h_{max} = 1000 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 1,734 = \mathbf{17,0 \, \text{kPa}}$$
$$p_{dmin} = \rho \cdot g \cdot h_{min} = 1000 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 0,266 = \mathbf{2,6 \, \text{kPa}}$$

```{=html}
<div class="mf1-lab" id="widget-z32-advanced" style="max-width: 980px; margin: 2rem auto; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid #dbe7f3; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%); border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.08);">
    <div class="z32-head">
        <div>
            <div class="z32-kicker">Z32 laboratorij tlaka na dnu</div>
            <h4 class="z32-title">U otvorenom ubrzanom spremniku tlak na dnu ovisi o lokalnoj visini stupca, ne o jednom globalnom nivou</h4>
            <p class="z32-sub">Nagnuta slobodna površina daje različite visine stupca na krajevima dna. Tlak se zato određuje iz lokalnih h<sub>max</sub> i h<sub>min</sub>, a ne jednom vrijednošću za cijelo dno.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="z32-note">
            <div style="font-weight:800; color:#93c5fd; margin-bottom:4px;">Slijed proračuna</div>

            <div><strong>h<sub>max/min</sub> = h₀ ± L tanα/2</strong></div>
            <div><strong>∂p/∂x = −ρa<sub>x</sub></strong>; <strong>p<sub>d</sub> = ρgh</strong> lokalno</div>

    </div>
    <div class="z32-layout">
        <div class="z32-layout-main">
            <div class="z32-scene"><canvas id="z32-canvas" width="900" height="340"></canvas></div>
            <div class="z32-explainer" id="z32-explainer"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="z32-layout-side">
            <div class="z32-controls">
                <div class="z32-control">
                    <label>Horizontalno ubrzanje aₓ: <span id="z32-v-a" style="color:#2563eb;">2.4</span> m/s²</label>
                    <input type="range" id="z32-a" min="0" max="8" step="0.1" value="2.4" style="accent-color:#2563eb;">
                </div>
                <div class="z32-control">
                    <label>Duljina spremnika L: <span id="z32-v-l" style="color:#1d4ed8;">6.0</span> m</label>
                    <input type="range" id="z32-l" min="2" max="8" step="0.1" value="6.0" style="accent-color:#1d4ed8;">
                </div>
                <div class="z32-control">
                    <label>Početna razina h₀: <span id="z32-v-h0" style="color:#0f766e;">1.00</span> m</label>
                    <input type="range" id="z32-h0" min="0.2" max="1.8" step="0.01" value="1.0" style="accent-color:#0f766e;">
                </div>
                <div class="z32-control">
                    <label>Gustoća fluida ρ: <span id="z32-v-rho" style="color:#7c3aed;">1000</span> kg/m³</label>
                    <input type="range" id="z32-rho" min="900" max="1200" step="5" value="1000" style="accent-color:#7c3aed;">
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="z32-impact">
                <div class="z32-impact-card"><small>Geometrija</small><strong id="z32-impact-1">aₓ i L određuju α</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-impact-card"><small>Razlika dubina</small><strong id="z32-impact-2">raste razlika h_max-h_min</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-impact-card"><small>Tlak na dnu</small><strong id="z32-impact-3">tlak je lokalan: p=ρgh</strong></div>
            </div>
            <div class="z32-explainer" id="z32-band" style="margin-bottom:12px; font-weight:700;">Režim: obje visine su fizikalno valjane.</div>
            <div class="z32-metrics">
                <div class="z32-metric"><small>Kut α</small><strong style="color:#0f172a;"><span id="z32-res-alpha">13.8</span>°</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-metric"><small>h_max na dnu</small><strong style="color:#1d4ed8;"><span id="z32-res-hmax">1.734</span> m</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-metric"><small>h_min na dnu</small><strong style="color:#0f766e;"><span id="z32-res-hmin">0.266</span> m</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-metric"><small>p_dmax / p_dmin</small><strong style="color:#b45309;"><span id="z32-res-pmax">17.0</span> / <span id="z32-res-pmin">2.6</span> kPa</strong></div>
                <div class="z32-metric"><small>Omjer aₓ/g</small><strong style="color:#7c3aed;"><span id="z32-res-fr">0.245</span></strong></div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <script>
    (function() {
        const canvas = document.getElementById('z32-canvas');
        const hd = window.mf1HiDpiCanvas ? window.mf1HiDpiCanvas(canvas) : null;
        const ctx = hd ? hd.ctx : canvas.getContext('2d');
        const canvasW = hd ? hd.logicalWidth : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('width'), 10) || canvas.width);
        const canvasH = hd ? hd.logicalHeight : (parseInt(canvas.getAttribute('height'), 10) || canvas.height);
        const aS = document.getElementById('z32-a');
        const lS = document.getElementById('z32-l');
        const h0S = document.getElementById('z32-h0');
        const rhoS = document.getElementById('z32-rho');
        const bandEl = document.getElementById('z32-band');

        function update() {
            const a = parseFloat(aS.value);
            const L = parseFloat(lS.value);
            const h0 = parseFloat(h0S.value);
            const rho = parseFloat(rhoS.value);
            const g = 9.81;
            const alpha = Math.atan(a / g);
            const slope = Math.tan(alpha);
            const rawMin = h0 - (L / 2) * slope;
            let hMax = h0 + (L / 2) * slope;
            let hMin = rawMin;
            let wetFraction = 1;
            if (rawMin < 0 && slope > 0) {
                const wetLength = Math.sqrt(2 * h0 * L / slope);
                wetFraction = Math.min(1, wetLength / L);
                hMax = slope * wetLength;
                hMin = 0;
            }
            const pMax = rho * g * hMax;
            const pMin = rho * g * hMin;
            const fr = a / g;
            const dp = (pMax - pMin) / 1000;

            document.getElementById('z32-v-a').textContent = a.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z32-v-l').textContent = L.toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z32-v-h0').textContent = h0.toFixed(2);
            document.getElementById('z32-v-rho').textContent = rho.toFixed(0);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-alpha').textContent = (alpha * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-hmax').textContent = hMax.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-hmin').textContent = hMin.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-pmax').textContent = (pMax / 1000).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-pmin').textContent = (pMin / 1000).toFixed(1);
            document.getElementById('z32-res-fr').textContent = fr.toFixed(3);
            document.getElementById('z32-impact-1').textContent = `α = ${(alpha * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°`;
            document.getElementById('z32-impact-2').textContent = `Δp_d ≈ ${dp.toFixed(1)} kPa`;

            if (hMin <= 0.001) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: prednji dio dna je suh; trokutasti profil čuva početni volumen tekućine.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fef2f2';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fecaca';
                bandEl.style.color = '#991b1b';
                document.getElementById('z32-impact-3').textContent = 'suho dno: granica modela';
            } else if (hMax >= 2.0) {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: profil doseže gornji rub na stražnjem kraju — dolazi do prelijevanja.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#fff7ed';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#fdba74';
                bandEl.style.color = '#9a3412';
                document.getElementById('z32-impact-3').textContent = 'stražnji kraj blizu vrha';
            } else {
                bandEl.textContent = 'Režim: cijelo je dno mokro i obje su krajnje visine fizikalno valjane.';
                bandEl.style.background = '#eff6ff';
                bandEl.style.borderColor = '#bfdbfe';
                bandEl.style.color = '#1e3a8a';
                document.getElementById('z32-impact-3').textContent = 'valjan režim na oba kraja';
            }

            document.getElementById('z32-explainer').textContent = `Za a=${a.toFixed(1)} m/s² i L=${L.toFixed(1)} m površina se naginje za ${(alpha * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°. Pri h₀=${h0.toFixed(2)} m dobiva se h_max=${hMax.toFixed(3)} m i h_min=${hMin.toFixed(3)} m, pa su tlakovi ${(pMax / 1000).toFixed(1)} i ${(pMin / 1000).toFixed(1)} kPa.`;
            draw(alpha, hMax, hMin, pMax, pMin, wetFraction);
        }

        function draw(alpha, hMax, hMin, pMax, pMin, wetFraction) {
            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasW, canvasH);
            const ox = 110;
            const oy = 285;
            const w = 560;
            const scale = 120;
            const hTank = 2.0 * scale;
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2937';
            ctx.lineWidth = 3;
            ctx.strokeRect(ox, oy - hTank, w, hTank);

            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(37,99,235,0.42)';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ox, oy - hMax * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w * wetFraction, oy - hMin * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w * wetFraction, oy);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w, oy);
            ctx.lineTo(ox, oy);
            ctx.fill();

            const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ox + w * wetFraction, oy - hMin * scale, ox, oy);
            grad.addColorStop(0, '#e0f2fe');
            grad.addColorStop(1, '#1d4ed8');
            ctx.fillStyle = grad;
            ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ox, oy - hMax * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w * wetFraction, oy - hMin * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w * wetFraction, oy);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w, oy);
            ctx.lineTo(ox, oy);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

            ctx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#ef4444';
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(ox - 20, oy - hMax * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + 18, oy - hMax * scale);
            ctx.moveTo(ox + w - 18, oy - hMin * scale);
            ctx.lineTo(ox + w + 20, oy - hMin * scale);
            ctx.stroke();
            ctx.setLineDash([]);

            // Raspodjela sile tlaka na dno: strelice su normale na dno i veće su pod dubljim stupcem.
            for (let i=0;i<=8;i+=1) {
                const fraction=i/8;
                const x=ox+fraction*w;
                const localH=fraction<=wetFraction ? hMax-(hMax-hMin)*(fraction/Math.max(wetFraction,0.001)) : 0;
                const arrowH=Math.min(52,Math.max(0,localH/hMax*48));
                if (arrowH<2) continue;
                ctx.strokeStyle='#4338ca';ctx.fillStyle='#4338ca';ctx.lineWidth=2.5;
                ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,oy-3);ctx.lineTo(x,oy-arrowH);ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,oy-arrowH);ctx.lineTo(x-5,oy-arrowH+8);ctx.lineTo(x+5,oy-arrowH+8);ctx.fill();
            }
            const vx=785,vy=105,axLen=Math.min(62,Math.tan(alpha)*210);
            const vector=(x1,y1,x2,y2,color,label) => {
                const angle=Math.atan2(y2-y1,x2-x1),head=8;
                ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x1,y1);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke();
                ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x2,y2);ctx.lineTo(x2-head*Math.cos(angle-.55),y2-head*Math.sin(angle-.55));ctx.lineTo(x2-head*Math.cos(angle+.55),y2-head*Math.sin(angle+.55));ctx.fill();
                ctx.font='700 12px Inter';ctx.fillText(label,x2+5,y2+4);
            };
            vector(vx,vy,vx,vy+72,'#d97706','g');
            vector(vx,vy,vx-axLen,vy,'#dc2626','−a');
            vector(vx,vy,vx-axLen,vy+72,'#16a34a','g_eff');
            ctx.fillStyle='#4338ca';ctx.font='700 12px Inter';ctx.fillText('lokalne sile tlaka na dno',250,332);

            ctx.fillStyle = '#0f172a';
            ctx.font = '800 14px Inter';
            ctx.fillText(`h_max = ${hMax.toFixed(3)} m`, ox + 12, 24);
            ctx.fillText(`h_min = ${hMin.toFixed(3)} m`, ox + w - 120, 24);
            ctx.fillText(`p_dmax = ${(pMax / 1000).toFixed(1)} kPa`, ox - 8, oy + 24);
            ctx.fillText(`p_dmin = ${(pMin / 1000).toFixed(1)} kPa`, ox + w - 22, oy + 24);
            ctx.fillText(`α = ${(alpha * 180 / Math.PI).toFixed(1)}°`, 730, 48);
        }

        [aS, lS, h0S, rhoS].forEach((slider) => slider.addEventListener('input', update));
        update();
    })();
    </script>
</div>

```

<hr class="zadatak-sep">

### Zadatak Z33 — Cisterna mlijeka: tlak u zatvorenom spremniku {.unnumbered}

Mlijeko gustoće $1020 \, \text{kg/m}^3$ transportira se pravocrtno cestom konstantnog nagiba unutar spremnika cisterne promjera 3 m, duljine 7 m. Spremnik je potpuno ispunjen mlijekom, pri čemu cisterna konstantno ubrzava intenzitetom $2,5 \, \text{m/s}^2$. Ukoliko minimalan tlak u spremniku iznosi 100 kPa, odredite maksimalan pretlak u spremniku te mjesto na kojemu se pojavljuje.

<div class="zadano-grid">
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Zadano</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$\rho_m$ = $1020 \, \text{kg/m}^3$, $d$ = $3 \, \text{m}$, $l$ = $7 \, \text{m}$, $a_x$ = $2,5 \, \text{m/s}^2$, $p_{min}$ = $100 \, \text{kPa}$</span>
</div>
<div class="zadano-row">
<span class="label">Odrediti</span>
<span class="zadano-text">$p_{pmax} = ?$; mjesto maksimalnog tlaka</span>
</div>
</div>
<div class="rjesenje-label">Rješenje</div>

Prema izvornom crtežu nagib ceste je $\beta=0^\circ$, pa je uzdužna os cisterne vodoravna. U sustavu vezanom uz cisternu vrijedi

$$\mathbf g_{eff}=\mathbf g-\mathbf a,\qquad p_2-p_1=\rho\mathbf g_{eff}\cdot(\mathbf r_2-\mathbf r_1).$$

Spremnik je potpuno pun: nema slobodne površine čiji bi se nagib određivao. Traže se krajnje vrijednosti **prostornog polja tlaka**. Za vodoravnu os cisterne projekcijski raspon pravokutnog uzdužnog presjeka duž $\mathbf g_{eff}$ daje $\rho a_xl+\rho gd$.

U zatvorenom spremniku bez slobodne površine, maksimalni tlak se pojavljuje u točki najudaljenijoj u smjeru rezultantne masene sile (donji stražnji rub ako se ubrzava naprijed).

Maksimalan apsolutni tlak:
$$p_{max} = p_{min} + \rho \cdot a_x \cdot l + \rho \cdot g \cdot d$$
$$p_{max} = 100000 + 1020 \cdot 2,5 \cdot 7,0 + 1020 \cdot 9,81 \cdot 3,0 = \mathbf{147,7 \, \text{kPa}}$$

Maksimalan pretlak (uz atmosferski tlak 101,3 kPa):
$$p_{pmax} = p_{max} - p_{atm} = 147,7 - 101,3 = \mathbf{46,4 \, \text{kPa}}$$

    <div class="z33-head">
        <div>
            <div class="z33-kicker">Z33 laboratorij zatvorene cisterne</div>
            <h4 class="z33-title">Puna cisterna: krajnji tlakovi određuju se projekcijom na g<sub>eff</sub></h4>
